item.title: 修复（doctor）：为 SQLite 拥有的会话跳过旧版主记录检查（#119940）
item.summary: fix(doctor): skip legacy main transcript check for SQLite-owned sessions (#119940) * fix(doctor): skip legacy main transcript check for SQLite-owned sessions After the SQLite session import, the main session's legacy .jsonl is archived and 'sessions cleanup' prunes it as unreferenced, but doctor still warned 'Main session transcript missing' because the main-session check required the legacy file. The sibling recent-session check already skips SQLite-owned keys; apply the same ownership guard to the main session so doctor and cleanup agree. (#119926) * style(doctor): condense SQLite ownership comment Co-authored-by: 李琪0668001400 - --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
